svg.aria-label: Code-quality gate press for the SonarQube MCP server v1.32.0 (released Nov 11, 2026). A tape of code enters from the supply spool on the left, passes under the scanning head that reads it, then through the gate press; the lit-orange PASS lever throws the gate, clean code runs out right into the pass bin, and flagged issues drop as chips into the fix drawer pulled out below the press. The quality-gate dial reads PASS, and the readout plate carries the release number. Verified numbers: v1.32.0 Nov 11, 2026; v1.31.0 Nov 3, 2026 (OAuth complete); 7M+ developers, 75% of the Fortune 100; 5 MCP tools (search_sonar_issues_in_projects, list_quality_gates, get_project_quality_gate_status, analyze_code_snippet, get_raw_source); 3 deployment shapes (Cloud-hosted, Server-hosted, self-hosted Docker).
svg.text: v1.32.0 · NOV 11, 2026 · 5 MCP TOOLS · 3 DEPLOYMENTS · 7M+ DEVS · 75% FORTUNE 100
